privacy.title: Privacy information
privacy.intro: Soma is a personal, free project run by a natural person. Domain: somarecovery.app. Contact email: soma.recovery.app@gmail.com.
privacy.knownBody: The service is offered at somarecovery.app. The controller is a natural person. The current operational contact is soma.recovery.app@gmail.com.
privacy.identityBody: Pending review. A full legal name, tax ID, and address are not published here because they are not confirmed.
privacy.dataBody: The product may store an account (email, display name, birth year, biological sex, optional weight), substances and dates, journal, missions, achievements, progress, feedback, and sessions. This list describes the current product; final legal categories are pending.
privacy.basesBody: Pending review. No GDPR or other legal basis is asserted here.
privacy.specialBody: Pending review. Soma may collect substance-use and wellbeing information the user enters. This page does not claim that consent or another legal basis has already been validated.
privacy.retentionBody: Pending review. No retention periods are stated because they are not confirmed.
privacy.processorsBody: Pending review. Providers and their real roles are not listed until they are confirmed.
privacy.rightsBody: Pending review. Until a definitive procedure exists, the provisional contact is soma.recovery.app@gmail.com. That does not replace a confirmed legal channel.
privacy.deletionBody: From the account you can request deletion of the profile and associated product data. That does not necessarily mean backups and operational logs disappear immediately. No deadline is stated.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms are an educational draft for Soma (somarecovery.app). They are not a published contract.
terms.natureBody: Soma is an educational companion. Catalog curves and estimates are illustrative. They are not clinical measurements.
terms.limitsBody: Trajectories do not predict individual recovery and do not replace a health professional’s judgement.
terms.medicalBody: Soma does not diagnose, prescribe, or provide individualized medical treatment.
terms.useBody: People who use Soma are responsible for how they interpret the educational information and for not entering third-party data without a basis to do so. This text does not attempt to exclude legal liability in absolute terms.
terms.accountsBody: During closed beta, sign-up requires an invitation. The account holder must keep their credentials and can request deletion from the account itself.
terms.contactBody: Operational contact: soma.recovery.app@gmail.com. The controller is a natural person. Full legal identification is pending.
